text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — I'm about to land a small rewrite of the SDK snippets covering streaming + pagination retries. PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/842 (draft)
Jamie: Thanks — what's changing exactly? short summary pls
Maria: Main changes:
- unify Python/TS/Go examples to use the new retry helper (stream_with_retries)
- switch TS snippets to the latest streaming API (async iterator -> stream.on('data') example)
- add a tiny pagination cursor example showing deterministic backoff on 429s
- fix two broken links in the pagination guide
Kevin: Do you have a before/after snippet for the retry helper? saves me opening the PR
Maria: Yup, pasted a minimal Python example below:
```
# new helper usage
for chunk in stream_with_retries(client.generate, prompt, max_retries=3):
    process(chunk)
```
Old style was manual try/except + asyncio.sleep jitter in every example — duplication everywhere.
Olga: Nice. Are we keeping the simple one-liner example too? some users prefer easy-to-read sync-ish pseudo code in docs
Maria: Yes keeping a one-liner pseudo example for the quickstart, but the code snippets under "Robust Streaming" will show the helper.
Jamie: Anything that affects import paths or package versions? I need to update the TS example in the SDK repo
Maria: TS: change import from `@redwood/sdk/stream` to `@redwood/sdk/streaming` and update examples to use `for await (const c of client.stream(prompt))` -> we now prefer `const s = client.streaming.create(prompt)` then `s.on('data', ...)` (event style). Also bumped examples to SDK v2.1.0.
Kevin: Tests? examples are used in the docs smoke tests — do we need to add new fixtures
Maria: Yes, added a small fixture in docs/tests/fixtures/stream_retry.json and a new mocha test for the TS event style. The CI job passed locally.
Olga: Any risk of breaking older customers who copy-paste the old pattern from docs? Maybe add a deprecation note section
Maria: Good point. I added a short "Legacy patterns" note with the old example and a link to migration steps.
Jamie: I'll review the TS bits. Can you add a short Go snippet too? folks asked for Go streaming sample last week.
Maria: Added a tiny Go example that demonstrates using the helper wrapper `StreamWithRetries(ctx, client, req)` — it's intentionally minimal.
Kevin: Can we keep the retry policy configurable (exponential vs linear)? Example should show param names so users can tweak
Maria: Yep, helper exposes policy=("exponential" | "linear"), base_ms, max_ms. I'll surface that in the comment header.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR template requires a CHANGELOG entry and a docs-coverage label :robot_face:
Maria: Added changelog entry under Unreleased > SDK snippets and added docs-coverage label. Also fixed two anchor links that were 404ing.
Jamie: I'll do a pass in ~30m. If it looks good, merge and I'll sync the SDK examples repo with the new import path change.
Olga: Ping me if you want the Go owner to double-check the typings/examples.
Maria: Thanks all — aim to merge end of day. cc @Kevin @Jamie :thumbsup:
Jamie: :eyes: will check for flaky test patterns too
Kevin: Thanks — appreciate the cleanup, this will reduce copy/paste bugs.
Maria: Final note — added a tiny note in the console docs about token accounting during streaming so examples show cost implications.
